projects.title: Apps we have delivered
projects.fit: Have a service you want to bring to mobile? A product that is missing an app? Or an idea where you need to find the right first step? These are the kinds of briefs we have worked on.

domov.title: Domov pod palcem
domov.tagline: Smart-home control for iOS and Android
domov.problem: The owner of a smart home wanted to control lighting, blinds, gates, heating, heat recovery and air conditioning from one place – without switching between each manufacturer's app.
domov.delivered: We delivered a mobile app that configures itself for the household after sign-in and talks to it over a secured connection. Schedules for heating and other devices are included.
domov.decision: Every control sits within reach of the thumb of the hand holding the phone, so the home can be operated comfortably one-handed – with the shopping in the other.
domov.result: The delivered app covers complete control of the home, including scheduled modes.

stable.title: Smart Stable
stable.tagline: Operations app for a stable manager
stable.problem: The manager of a cattle stable needed an overview of the conditions inside and a way to control the equipment even when not on site.
stable.delivered: We delivered an iOS and Android app in which the manager controls fans, side tarpaulins and lighting, watches live sensor readings – temperature, humidity and CO₂ – and their last 24 hours in charts.
stable.decision: The app watches for undesirable conditions on its own. When readings drift or a device reports a fault, the manager gets a push notification instead of having to watch the screen.
stable.result: The app supports several stables of one operator and adapts to the signed-in user's permissions.

studanky.title: Studánky
studanky.tagline: An app for monitoring natural springs
studanky.problem: Hikers and locals have no reliable way to know which natural springs are flowing right now and whether the water is fine.
studanky.delivered: For the Studánky project we are developing a mobile app for monitoring the state of natural springs and planning trips. Users find springs on a map, scan a QR code at the spring and add the current state through a short questionnaire.
studanky.decision: Data collection relies on the people at the spring: a report takes a few taps, and damage can be reported directly to the spring's caretaker.
studanky.result: The app is in development. We keep adding springs and features.

process.title: We start with what is worth verifying.
process.intro: First we get to know your idea and situation. The introductory consultation is free. If a more detailed analysis or design is needed, we agree its scope and price in advance.
process.handover: After each stage we agree how to continue. You don't have to commit to the whole collaboration up front – sometimes the right step is a smaller experiment, a web solution, or not building yet.

free.title: Free introductory consultation
free.text: Usually 60–90 minutes. We go through your business, the intended users, existing systems and the main unknowns. You leave with a short recap and a proposed next step.

stages.title: We clarify the brief and propose a solution
stages.text: Within an agreed scope we examine user needs and the competition and propose what the first version should do. A simple, clear brief can go straight to a development proposal.
outputs: A brief for the first version and a prioritised scope
The key app flow or a prototype, as agreed
An estimate and a recommended next step

stages.title: We build the first usable version
stages.text: We focus on the users' main need. We show the app as it takes shape and prepare it for release. A first version tests a concrete use case – it does not guarantee demand or revenue.
outputs: A working app for iOS and Android
The necessary supporting systems and testing
An agreed release to the App Store and Google Play

stages.title: We develop it based on real use
stages.text: After launch we handle operations and plan further changes around user feedback and the needs of your business. Maintenance and development are agreed as separate services.

scope.title: The app and everything it needs.
scope.text: Where needed we also prepare a web administration, integration with your systems and the operation of the app. We design the parts so that they work together.

app.title: Mobile app
app.text: For iOS and Android – native or Flutter, whichever makes sense for your project.

admin.title: Web administration
admin.text: Managing content, users and settings without a developer.

backend.title: Technical background
backend.text: Server, integration with your systems and running the app after launch.

team.title: A team for your product.
paragraphs: We bring design, development and operations into one collaboration. We work through priorities with you, show finished work and agree the next steps.
We are a small team from Prague. You talk directly to the people who design and build the app – the brief, the decisions and the code stay with the project, not in one supplier's head.

items.question: Do I need a finished brief?
items.answer: No. The introductory consultation is free and is there for us to get to know your situation and idea. More detailed research, analysis and solution design are priced by the agreed scope. Paid work starts only after your approval.

items.question: How much does development cost?
items.answer: The price depends on what the first version should do and which systems it connects to. After the introductory consultation we propose the next step. For a clearly defined brief we offer a fixed price; for staged development we agree a budget and priorities.

items.question: How long does a first version take?
items.answer: It depends on the scope of the first version and the systems it connects to. We give a timeline estimate once it is clear what the first version should do – usually after the introductory consultation or after clarifying the brief.

items.question: Do you also handle administration and operations?
items.answer: Yes, where they are part of the agreed delivery. A web administration lets you manage content and users without a developer. Operations cover the server, updates and keeping an eye on the app running.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We agree maintenance and further development based on what real use shows. Changes are planned around priorities and an agreed budget – a clear agreement, not unlimited support.

items.question: Can we build on an existing app?
items.answer: Yes. We first assess the existing app and agree the best next step. A rewrite from scratch is not the default recommendation.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page describes which personal data we process on smolikja.team, for what purpose and what rights you have.

sections.title: Who processes the data
paragraphs: The data controller is smolikja team, Prague. For anything concerning personal data, contact us at {email}.

sections.title: Contact form
paragraphs: When you write to us through the form, we process your name, e-mail address and the text of your message. The purpose is to answer your enquiry and arrange a possible collaboration; the legal basis is pre-contractual negotiation and our legitimate interest in handling the enquiry.

The message is delivered to our mailbox by Resend (Resend, Inc., USA) acting as a processor. We keep the data for as long as needed to handle the enquiry and any resulting collaboration, then delete it.
To protect the form from abuse we briefly keep a hash of the sender's IP address; it expires after 24 hours at most.

sections.title: Cookies and analytics
paragraphs: The site uses no analytics or marketing cookies and does not track your behaviour. We store a single technical cookie, NEXT_LOCALE, with the language you chose, valid for one year.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict processing and to object. Just write to the e-mail above. You can also lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection.
